inputDiagnosticBinaryLabelFromRoot: f98; exact source hashes authoritative; no binary/device access

correlation.context: String of existing audioCoach ObjectIdentifier plus plan.id; no object retained. Diagnostic registry contains only String/Int collections.
correlation.singleWorkoutValidity: Future observation gate must require exactly one context and appearance, all relevant associationValid=true, and no startup-association-ambiguous event. Same-plan concurrent or reappearing views cannot be distinguished and invalidate association; this is not a production behavior guard.
correlation.request: Each request gets a fresh local UUID. Synchronous scope is pushed/popped without suspension. A deferred audio dispatch consumes the prior pending ID; a subsequent request is a new child ID with explicit parentAttemptID. Direct beginVisibly uses the original deferred ID.
correlation.task: Task captures immutable local startupAttemptID and startupContext. Entry/resume/catch use that explicit ID, never a latest-global request ID. Only after the original await and cancellation guard is the captured ID pushed around synchronous beginVisibleCountdown.
correlation.cancelRequested: Each of four existing optional cancel call sites emits actual task/pending presence plus their associated IDs. Nil optional invocations are explicitly distinguishable from actual task cancellation requests. Only diagnostic maps are cleared.
correlation.cancelObserved: The existing Task.sleep catch emits startup-arm-task-cancelled with captured ID. A resumed event includes Task.isCancelled immediately before the unchanged guard; true means cancellation observed at that guard. These are distinct from request markers.
correlation.lateCompletion: Old task completion after armed association changes logs ambiguity. It does not suppress the original task=nil assignment or countdown mutation.
correlation.audioChange: The raw audio preparation callback has no inferred pending attempt ID outside synchronous scope; the subsequent explicit deferred-dispatch binds the consumed request. If mapping is missing/ambiguous, null ID and ambiguity remain visible.
correlation.surface: Each existing Surface Task gets a local UUID when enabled. Load-call/return/ready/error share it. No model/scene/coach is captured for new bookkeeping.

preservedBehavior: All original source lines remain in order: three reserved files only; additions are DEBUG-scoped.
No added observable state, @State, Task, await, sleep, observer, timer, body logging, UIKit census, entity access or lazy hand read.
All original scheduling expressions, production signatures, actor annotations, mutations, callback conditions and cancellation guards remain unchanged.
No change to geometry, renderer state, audio schedule, training content, packages or review records.
observationProtocol: Bound observation to 30 seconds from recorded workout appearance; do not extend for missing stages.
Require one context/appearance and no ambiguous association to claim complete attempt linkage.
Use existing timestamps and explicit planned armUptime/actual activeStartUptime; nil numeric fields remain NSNull.
Missing endpoint or events after the bound are right-censored, not evidence of no work.
Existing scene-construction/make events retain their original meaning; no new host identity or presented-frame assertion.
limits: Read-only apply-check and textual source invariants only; no Swift parse/typecheck/build or runtime trial.
The required correlation registry expands the patch from 173 to 354 diff lines; it remains scalar diagnostic bookkeeping in the same three files.
Scalar allocation, UUID generation and synchronous event serialization/file I/O can perturb actor timing; measured spans include observer overhead.
No registry association can prove same-plan concurrent view identity; such appearances/overlap are rejected by evidence validity, never by production logic.
An audio callback without a consumed deferred request remains intentionally unassociated rather than guessed.
A Surface Task cancelled before its existing first guard emits no startup load marker.
Task catch identifies the existing sleep failure/cancellation path; it does not establish why a task was cancelled beyond separately observed requests.
This proposal authorizes no application, build, device access or next experiment and makes no root-cause/fix claim.
